verification.validation: Basic release gate (bash scripts/gate.sh) run as root, where the Node and Python tests that refuse to run as root and the Go tests that need the package account fail identically on the previous release; policy, version and executor manifest checks, Go vet/build and units, Node typecheck/build, frontend gate, packed consumer import, pack and content scans; both npm tarballs scanned for internal content and secrets before publication. New idgateway and ipc unix-upstream tests pass under the race detector. No full gate, QEMU, executor rebuild, Rust build, crate publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: The identity gateway upstream can be unix:/var/packages/<Package>/var/run/<name>.sock, the App's own private SDK IPC socket, so an App behind path ingress needs no TCP port (idgateway.UnixUpstreamVersion = 1). Other packages' paths, nested or relative paths, non-.sock names and compose_ingress are refused at configuration load. Upgraded connections have no gateway deadline.
Add ipc.DialPackageUnix, ipc.DialUnix with an explicit package for binaries without a bound identity.
Reuse executor 0.53.6 unchanged: executor sources and build inputs are unchanged.
